name: Smart Line Namer
summary: Line names you can read at a glance: town, vehicle and route, grouped and sorted for you.
description:
Tired of "Line 14", "Line 15", "Line 16"? Smart Line Namer gives every line a name that tells you what it is and where it goes, so you can find the right line in a long list without opening it.

HOW NAMES LOOK

Local lines start with their town:
• Gukovo · Bus: Center — North
• Gukovo · Tram: Railway Station — North
• Gukovo · Bus: Loop

Lines between towns start with Intercity:
• Intercity · Train: Gukovo — Chekalin
• Intercity · Train: Gukovo — Chekalin via Orel

Freight lines show their cargo, unless the industry makes only one product:
• Gukovo · Truck: Crop Farm — Brewery (Grain)
• Gukovo · Truck: Quarry — Cement Plant

WHY THIS ORDER

The line list is sorted alphabetically, so the first word decides where a line ends up:
• all lines of a town stay together, grouped by vehicle;
• all intercity lines form their own block, grouped by vehicle.

WHAT IT KNOWS

• Vehicle: bus, truck, tram, train, plane or ship, taken from the line's vehicles or stations.
• Stops are named by place: Railway Station, Bus Station, Airport, Port, Center, Industrial Zone, or a direction from the center (North, South, East, West). Two stops with the same name in a town are numbered (North, North 2).
• Industry stops get a short industry name (Coal Mine, Crop Farm, Refinery) and belong to the closest town.
• Intercity routes: the town of the first stop, the other end town, and the town with the most stops in between (via). The via part is left out when the name would not fit the line list.
• Circular lines are marked as Loop.
• Cargo: the cargo loaded at the most stops, plus a count of the others. Left out when it is obvious from the industry.
• Two lines that would get the same name are numbered (… 2, … 3). Renaming again keeps the same numbers.

HOW TO USE

Open the line manager, select one or more lines, press the auto-rename (wand) button and choose "Town - Vehicle - Route". The vanilla schemes are still there.

Safe to add or remove at any time: the mod only sets line names, and the names stay if you remove it.

Languages: English, Russian.
